card.name: Last piece of a drug name before 'is used'
card.fires_on: The final piece of a drug name that is the subject of a sentence, right before a verb like 'is' or 'was' or a phrase like 'is also' or 'is administered with'. It is found in interaction and combination-use statements.

modes.label: Drug name ending
modes.description: The last piece of a split drug or brand name, right before 'is' or 'was' plus a use or co-administration phrase.
modes.example: Myelosuppression may be increased when MERCAPTOPUR<<INE>> is coadministered with other drugs

modes.label: Other subject word
modes.description: A subject noun or place name just before a verb, outside the drug-name pattern.
modes.example: Bharat<<pur>> is also considered the finest Heronry

card.plain: It fires at the end of a drug's name when the sentence is about to say what happens when that drug is used with others.
